title: SendGrid key in provider-specific fields: must be flagged
summary: The complete SendGrid key shape (base62 body, URL-safe `-`/`_`, trailing `-`) bare and in provider-named environment fields. Covers 9 inputs.
rationale: The complete shape has punctuation inside and at the end of the value. Extent errors here either drop the last characters or split the value at a separator.

expectation.rationale: Source-backed lexical shape in an explicit context test; repeated shapes are not independent provider coverage.
